response.original_title: How to be a better serial killer
response.overview: It’s 2026, the job market is shit. Someone calls into a radio show, The Unemployment Line, where you can get tips on how to improve your skills and get help seeking a job. However, when a bizarre call throws the host off kilter, the unsuspecting host gives helpful tips and motivates an aspiring serial killer to achieve their dream Will the caller succeed, who will be their next victim?
response.title: How to be a better serial killer
